احتقرتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرَتَا (iḥtaqaratā) /iħ.ta.qa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرَتَا (uḥtuqiratā) /uħ.tu.qi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
